name: CI runner host: Kueue webhook no ready endpoints — poweredge-xubuntu ci_kueue.webhook_ready_endpoints < 1
description: Fires when MIN(livespec.ci_kueue.webhook_ready_endpoints) for host.name=poweredge-xubuntu over the trailing 10 min is below 1: the Kueue admission webhook (kueue-webhook-service, ns kueue-system) had ZERO ready endpoints in a probe, so NO runner pod is admitted. Window is two probe intervals: a 5-min MAX window matched the drifting OnUnitActiveSec=5min timer, went empty on 6-min gaps and fired as 0 with every sample at 2 (10-31 20:12Z, 11-04 05:12Z and 13:37Z; livespec-dev-tooling-7jmpyz). A silent probe is the CI runner host dead-man's job. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-kueue-webhook-probe.sh. Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> env livespec. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n kueue-system get endpoints kueue-webhook-service -o wide.
